annotations.title: Check the claims in a message

description: Pass the message you are about to send to the user. SkeptOpus finds every claim of work done in it and looks, on this machine and on GitHub: commits in git, pushes on the remote, pull requests and merges, the test command the user declared re-run, files on disk, comments and repositories on GitHub, declared measurements redone. Returns one verdict per claim and the verdict of the whole message (as good as its weakest claim). It changes nothing.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the project folder the work happened in. Always pass it: some editors start this server in the home folder, where there is nothing to see.

lang.description: Language of the explanations. Defaults to the user's setting.

message.description: The words you are about to say, exactly as the user would read them.

name: check

hint.description: Present when nothing could be seen because no project folder was given.
